reason: Connects DSH to supported physical devices through raw macOS BLE discovery, Intiface, or MonsterParty and exposes scan, connection, bounded control, stop, and disconnect tools.

summaries.zh: 连接 DSH 与受支持的蓝牙、串口、USB 或共享链接设备，并提供发现、连接、控制、停止和断开工具。
summaries.en: Connects DSH to supported Bluetooth, serial, USB, or sharing-link devices and provides tools for discovery, connection, bounded control, stopping, and disconnection.

capabilities: Discovers nearby Bluetooth hardware on macOS
Connects to supported Bluetooth, serial, USB, and relay-backed devices
Sends bounded scalar control commands and stop commands
Starts or downloads a pinned local Intiface Engine when configured
Uses configured sharing tokens for supported relay connections
